title: enforce-cmk-scope-and-signed-audit-envelopes
author: Maya Torres
description: Motivation: Private installs must guarantee that customer-managed keys (CMKs) and audit logs cannot be accidentally routed to an out-of-scope region or tenant boundary. This PR introduces an installer-side enforcement layer that 1) binds CMK selection to explicit organizational scope labels (org_id and location_tag), 2) validates key origin at runtime during first-boot and upgrade flows, and 3) encapsulates audit events in signed envelopes before forwarding to remote collectors.
commits: 8a4f7c3 - installer: add org-scoped CMK selector and validation
b1d2f66 - audit: introduce envelope proxy and signing util (ed25519)
c3e5ab9 - charts: expose cmkScope and auditEnvelope toggles in values.yaml
f7e9d11 - e2e: add smoke tests for cmk scope enforcement during bootstrap
d2b8c20 - docs: upgrade installer docs with configuration examples and migration notes
review_comments: Arjun Patel: Can we avoid an installer-wide secret for signing and instead wire to KMS-backed ephemeral keys? (commented on installer/audit/signing_util.go)

Maya Torres: Answered: we generate a node-local ephemeral key on first boot and wrap it with the tenant CMK; the signing util persists only the wrapped blob. Added comments and tests to prove unwrap path.
Leah Kim: Request change: add a toggle to disable envelope signing for air-gapped deploys and document the compliance implications.
Maya Torres: Added 'auditEnvelope.enabled' switch in Helm values.yaml with clear warning in docs. Kept enforced validation of CMK origin even when signing is disabled.
Daniel Ortiz: Noted potential race in bootstrap_flow when KMS endpoint is unreachable; suggested fallback backoff and clearer failure messages.
Maya Torres: Implemented exponential backoff and a distinct installer exit code when CMK validation fails so ops can surface the exact cause in telemetry.
ci_checks: integration-tests: flaky failure on first run (kms emulator timeout) - rerun succeeded
release_notes: Installer: enforce CMK selection by org scope and add signed audit envelopes for remote collectors. New Helm toggles: 'cmkScope.orgId', 'cmkScope.locationTag', 'auditEnvelope.enabled'. Migration: nodes will validate and rewrap keys on first boot; see docs/private-installer/cmk-and-audit.md for rollback and air-gap guidance.
notes: This change tightens compliance posture for Private deployments without changing hosted platform behavior. Ops teams should coordinate upgrades because nodes will attempt CMK validation during bootstrap; failure will prevent service start by design.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: core installer behavior changes on boot path. Tested in staging with multi-tenant tag permutations. Added feature flags to disable signing for constrained environments.
changelog_entry: private-installer: add org-scoped CMK enforcement + signed audit envelopes
security_impact: Enhances server-side enforcement of key residency and audit authenticity. No changes to API surface but adds signer artifact handling during install; secrets are wrapped with tenant CMK.
migration_instructions: Operators upgrading to this release must: 1) ensure their tenant CMKs are available to installer nodes, 2) set cmkScope.orgId and cmkScope.locationTag in values.yaml, 3) if air-gapped, optionally set auditEnvelope.enabled=false and follow the documented audit collection strategy. See docs/private-installer/cmk-and-audit.md for detailed steps.
observability_changes: Added metrics: installer.cmk_validation.success, installer.cmk_validation.failure_reason, installer.audit_envelope.signed_count. Logs include 'cmk_validation_source' and 'envelope_sign_status' for troubleshooting.
qa_notes: Added e2e test that simulates a mismatched CMK origin and verifies installer aborts with code 42. Added smoke test for envelope signing and unwrap path using KMS emulator. Tests are gated behind 'security' tag in CI.
author_acknowledgement: I confirm this PR includes unit and integration tests, docs updates, and feature flags where appropriate. - Maya Torres
